'''Lake Varum''' was a body of [[Water/Legends|water]] that bordered the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Description==
Lake Varum was a body of [[Water/Legends|water]] located on the<ref name="Secrets" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Secrets" />

==History==
The lake bordered the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]]. It abutted various areas of the city, including the [[Industrial District (Keren)|Industrial District]], [[City Government Complex]] and [[Marina District/Legends|Marina District]]<ref name="Secrets" /> A gazebo was also located on the lake.<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Lake Varum first appeared in the [[2001]] paperback supplement to the [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', ''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''.<ref name="Secrets" /> The lake later appeared in the the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="AED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> While it was not explicitly identified, the game included a large lake near the [[W:c:swg:City|city]] of [[W:c:swg:Keren|Keren]].<ref name="AED" />
